summary: Every load-bearing claim in the single-node graph survives adversarial checking at ref 9725f16. The convergence reason for mirroring raw=/on_issue= onto fetch_by_provider is true on source: both public functions terminate in _fetch_provider_series and return the same four-member ObservationResult, differing only by provider partitioning. The issue-policy mechanics the graph specifies are not new -- they are the existing per-series on_issue="ignore" -> merge -> single apply_on_issue shape at discovery.py:150-161, and apply_on_issue never filters issues, so per-series ignoring cannot swallow anything; the policy is applied exactly once, never twice. ADR-0018's invariant holds because retention is decided solely by `raw is RawMode.INCLUDE` inside driver.drive, so a boundary bool converted to RawMode changes no retained bytes. The export removal is exactly one name and reconciles arithmetically with m9's seven without ordering, RawMode and OnIssue remain internally reachable through _internal imports in every src consumer, and the three package-root RawMode test sites are all covered by the step's stated acceptance evidence. No version bump, no tag, no Scope-Out work, no legacy deletion. The graph has no edges, which is correct here -- there is nothing to refute and nothing missing to add. The single-step decomposition is sustained by the fact that the bool's arrival and RawMode's departure are one substitution under one human justification. APPROVE.
